description: RAG / Agent / Observability / Compliance layer: vector_store.py, hitl.py, copilot_metrics.py, agent_graph.py, compliance_irdai.py, and their unit tests. Depends on FEAT-002 (agent calls ML models) and FEAT-003 (agent_graph imports HITLQueue). Build in order: hitl -> copilot_metrics -> vector_store -> compliance_irdai -> agent_graph (which ties them all together) -> tests.
steps: Write src/hitl.py. Pydantic v2 HITLItem: item_id (str, default_factory=lambda: uuid4().hex), session_id (str), context_type (str, e.g. 'underwriting'/'claims'), decision_draft (str), model_result (dict), analyst_review (Optional[str]=None), status (Literal['pending','approved','rejected','escalated']='pending'), created_at (datetime=default_factory=datetime.utcnow), reviewed_at (Optional[datetime]=None). HITLQueue: items: list[HITLItem] = []; lock: threading.Lock. enqueue(item: HITLItem): acquire lock, append, optionally persist to data/hitl_queue.json. get_pending() -> list[HITLItem]: return [i for i in items if i.status=='pending']. review(item_id: str, decision: Literal['approved','rejected','escalated'], analyst_notes: str = '') -> Optional[HITLItem]: find item by item_id, update status and analyst_review and reviewed_at, persist, return updated item. Module-level singleton: hitl_queue = HITLQueue().

Write src/copilot_metrics.py. Import guard: try: from prometheus_client import Counter, Histogram, Gauge; HAS_PROMETHEUS=True; except ImportError: HAS_PROMETHEUS=False. If HAS_PROMETHEUS: define all 7 metrics. If not: define stub objects with no-op inc/observe/set methods. Helper functions: record_agent_run(agent_name: str, duration_seconds: float), record_tool_call(tool_name: str), record_retriever_hit(), record_decision_drafted(), set_hitl_queue_depth(n: int), record_graph_query(). Each helper wraps the corresponding metric call in try/except to never raise.

Write src/vector_store.py. Import guards for chromadb and sentence_transformers. PolicyVectorStore: __init__(docs_dir: Path = Path('data/policy_docs'), persist_dir: Path = Path('data/chroma_db')). _load_and_chunk(text: str, source: str) -> list[dict]: split text into 300-char chunks with 50-char overlap, return list of {content, source}. build_index(): read all .txt files from docs_dir; chunk each; if HAS_CHROMA and HAS_ST: embed with SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2') and upsert to ChromaDB collection 'policy_docs'. search(query: str, top_k: int = 3) -> list[dict]: if not HAS_CHROMA or not HAS_ST: return []; query the collection, return list of {content, source, score}. Module-level singleton: policy_store = PolicyVectorStore(). Call policy_store.build_index() lazily (on first search call, not at import time).

Write src/compliance_irdai.py. Pydantic v2 IRDAIControl: control_id (str), title (str), description (str), category (str), status (Literal['compliant','partial','non_compliant']), evidence (str), remediation (str), severity (Literal['high','medium','low']). Pydantic v2 ComplianceReport: report_id (str, default_factory=lambda:uuid4().hex), generated_at (datetime=utcnow), overall_score (float 0-100), controls (list[IRDAIControl]), summary (str). generate_compliance_report() -> ComplianceReport: define 10 controls covering: (1) Claim Settlement 30 Days (IRDAI Reg 2015, high, demo: partial), (2) KYC Verification (high, compliant), (3) Grievance Redressal 15 Days (medium, compliant), (4) Policy Issuance SLA 15 Days (medium, compliant), (5) Premium Refund on Cancellation (high, partial), (6) Free-Look Period 15-30 Days (medium, compliant), (7) Health Insurance Portability (medium, partial), (8) AML/CFT Checks (high, compliant), (9) Fraud Reporting to IRDAI (high, partial), (10) Data Localisation (medium, non_compliant). overall_score = (compliant*100 + partial*50) / (total*100) * 100. summary: f'{compliant} compliant, {partial} partial, {non_compliant} non-compliant out of {total} controls.'

Write src/agent_graph.py. CopilotState TypedDict: query (str), context_type (str), features (dict), retrieved_docs (list[dict]), model_result (dict), decision_draft (str), requires_human_review (bool), session_id (str), timestamp (str). Import guards: HAS_LANGGRAPH, HAS_LANGCHAIN, HAS_GROQ. Node functions (plain Python, no LangGraph binding at this level): retriever_agent(state) -> dict: calls policy_store.search(state['query']); records retriever hit metric; returns {'retrieved_docs': results}. tool_agent(state) -> dict: if context_type=='underwriting' calls UnderwritingEngine().predict(); if 'claims' calls FraudDetectionEngine().predict(); records tool call metric; returns {'model_result': result.model_dump()}. writer_agent(state) -> dict: if HAS_GROQ and GROQ_API_KEY set, call Groq llama3-8b-8192 with a prompt combining retrieved_docs and model_result; else use rule-based template ('Based on retrieved policy clauses: {docs}. Model assessment: risk_score={score}. Recommendation: refer to analyst review.'); records decision drafted metric; returns {'decision_draft': text}. hitl_router(state) -> dict: enqueues HITLItem to hitl_queue; sets hitl queue depth metric; returns {'requires_human_review': True}. run_copilot_fallback(state: CopilotState) -> CopilotState: call each node function in sequence, merge updates into state dict, return. If HAS_LANGGRAPH: build StateGraph with these 4 nodes, edges retriever->tool->writer->hitl, compile; run_copilot(state) invokes compiled graph. Else: run_copilot = run_copilot_fallback.

Write tests/test_agent_graph.py: (1) test_run_copilot_fallback: construct minimal CopilotState dict, call run_copilot_fallback, assert result['requires_human_review'] is True and 'decision_draft' is a non-empty string. (2) test_hitl_enqueue: after running fallback, check hitl_queue.get_pending() has at least one item. Use monkeypatch to avoid real model training in tool_agent if needed (mock tool_agent to return a fixed model_result).

Write tests/test_compliance.py: (1) test_generate_report: call generate_compliance_report(), assert returns ComplianceReport, len(report.controls) >= 5, 0 <= report.overall_score <= 100. (2) test_control_fields: assert every control has non-empty title, description, evidence, remediation.
acceptance_criteria: run_copilot_fallback always sets requires_human_review=True regardless of other state
All src modules in this FEAT import cleanly even if langgraph/chromadb/sentence_transformers/prometheus_client are absent
policy_store.search('coverage') returns a list (possibly empty) without raising exceptions

python -c "from src.copilot_metrics import record_agent_run; record_agent_run('retriever', 0.5); print('metrics OK')"
python -c "from src.vector_store import PolicyVectorStore; print('vector_store OK')"
python -c "from src.compliance_irdai import generate_compliance_report; r=generate_compliance_report(); print(f'score={r.overall_score:.1f}%')"
python -c "from src.agent_graph import run_copilot_fallback; print('agent_graph OK')"
